page_title: LAZ 0-3 INT | Lazio v Inter 09/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
89' Mattia Mosconi (Inter) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
85' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Rosario Abisso ignores the protests.
84' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
83' Davide Frattesi (Inter) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
80' Here is a change. Petar Sucic is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Mattia Mosconi (Inter).
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) for Adam Marusic.
76' 0 - 3 Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Ange-Yoan Bonny, and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the roof of the net. He makes it 0:3.
74' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) was probably a bit loose with his words to Rosario Abisso, who decides to show him a yellow.
73' A cross from a corner kick by Lazio is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
73' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that Josep Martinez expertly pushes away. The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
72' None of the Lazio players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

71' Lazio are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Toma Basic (Lazio) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

70' A neat pass is well received by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. Lazio get a corner.
63' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Bastoni will be replaced by Luis Henrique (Inter).
63' It's time for a substitution. Denzel Dumfries (Inter) comes on in place of Lautaro Martinez.
63' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) blazes well wide of the right post.
62' Substitution. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) on for Pedro.
62' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
59' He’s off! Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) gets his marching orders from referee Rosario Abisso after the VAR review.

59' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio), but referee Rosario Abisso must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
58' The booking goes to Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio).
56' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) replaces Mario Gila.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Cancellieri leaves the pitch and Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) comes on.
56' Nicolo Rovella will be replaced by Patric (Lazio).
56' Davide Frattesi (Inter) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well past the left post.
52' Pedro (Lazio) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Josep Martinez easily deals with the threat.
52' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
49' Yann Bisseck (Inter) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Edoardo Motta.
48' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) earns the yellow card.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Nicolo Barella is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
46' Cristian Chivu makes a switch. Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) is coming on in place of Marcus Thuram at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.

39' 0 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Petar Sucic (Inter) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
36' Referee Rosario Abisso sees the trip by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
31' Nicolo Barella (Inter) fires a wonderful strike towards goal, but it's a whisker wide of the left post.
30' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle after Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Inter earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
26' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
23' Andy Diouf (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' Nicolo Barella (Inter) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

20' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Marcus Thuram (Inter) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
17' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
14' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) sees his mid-range free kick perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
12' Dangerous play by Nicolo Barella (Inter). Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Lazio.
12' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Edoardo Motta intercepts the ball.
11' Marcus Thuram (Inter) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
6' 0 - 1 Goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
6' Andy Diouf (Inter) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lazio will have the kick-off.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
